description: This script analyzes device tree binding changes between two commits, generating human-readable release notes in reStructuredText format. It loads binding data from specific commits, compares them, and outputs the differences, including added, removed, and modified bindings and properties.

classes.name: Compat
classes.description: Represents a (compatible, on_bus) pair used as a key for device tree bindings.

classes.name: Changes
classes.description: Container for all changes between two commits, including added, removed, and modified bindings.

classes.name: ModifiedSpecifier2Cells
classes.description: Represents a change in specifier cells for a specific space.

classes.name: ModifiedBuses
classes.description: Represents a change in bus list.

classes.name: AddedProperty
classes.description: Represents an added property in a binding.

classes.name: RemovedProperty
classes.description: Represents a removed property from a binding.

classes.name: ModifiedPropertyType
classes.description: Represents a change in property type.

classes.name: ModifiedPropertyEnum
classes.description: Represents a change in property enum values.

classes.name: ModifiedPropertyConst
classes.description: Represents a change in property constant value.

classes.name: ModifiedPropertyDefault
classes.description: Represents a change in property default value.

classes.name: ModifiedPropertyDeprecated
classes.description: Represents a change in property deprecation status.

classes.name: ModifiedPropertyRequired
classes.description: Represents a change in property required status.

methods.name: get_changes_between
methods.description: Computes the differences between start and end compat2binding mappings, returning a Changes object.

methods.name: load_compat2binding
methods.description: Loads device tree bindings from a specific commit into a mapping from Compat to Binding.

methods.name: get_binding2changes
methods.description: Determines changes between two Binding states for each Compat key.

methods.name: get_binding_changes
methods.description: Enumerates specific changes between two Binding objects.

methods.name: get_modified_specifier2cells
methods.description: Detects changes in specifier cells for a given space.

methods.name: get_added_properties
methods.description: Finds properties added in the end binding.

methods.name: get_removed_properties
methods.description: Finds properties removed in the end binding.

methods.name: get_modified_property_enum
methods.description: Detects changes in property enum values.

methods.name: get_modified_property_const
methods.description: Detects changes in property constant value.

methods.name: get_modified_property_default
methods.description: Detects changes in property default value.

methods.name: get_modified_property_deprecated
methods.description: Detects changes in property deprecation status.

methods.name: get_modified_property_required
methods.description: Detects changes in property required status.
